info.name: WeHelp Field Operations & Donation Management Backend API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection covering all endpoints for WeHelp Agent Mobile App and Admin Web Management.

Includes:
- Role-based Authentication (Admin/Agent) with auto-token extraction
- Dashboards & Real-time Metrics
- Live GPS Location Tracking & Google Maps Integration
- Attendance Check-In / Check-Out with GPS Coordinates & Reverse-Geocoded Address
- Daily Target Assignment & Progress Tracking
- Cash & Product/Grocery In-Kind Donations with Receipt Generation
- Organization Bank Details (Account 84278100000006) for UPI/QR
- Admin Financial Payment Records & Settlement
- Leave & Weekly-Off Request & Approval Workflow
- Field Agent Account Management

item.name: 1. Authentication & System Setup
item.description: Role-based login for Admins & Agents, JWT token refreshing, user profiles, and cloud database setup.

request.description: Authenticates with ADMIN role. Automatically extracts JWT access token and saves into collection variable {{admin_token}}.

exec: console.log("Admin JWT Access Token saved to {{admin_token}}");

request.description: Authenticates with AGENT role. Automatically extracts JWT access token and saves into collection variable {{agent_token}}.

exec: console.log("Agent JWT Access Token saved to {{agent_token}}");

request.description: Refreshes expired access token using the stored refresh token.
Fetches profile details, employee ID, assigned area, and active status for currently logged-in user.
Updates contact details for the authenticated user.
Initializes database migrations and seeds initial admin and agent users on fresh cloud deployments.

item.name: 2. Dashboards
item.description: High-level summary endpoints for Admin web dashboard and Agent mobile home screen.

request.description: Provides complete organization metrics: total collections, today's collections, active agents count, online agents, pending leave requests, pending verification records.
Provides agent's daily summary: today's collection amount, daily target progress, today's attendance check-in status, and recent donation receipts.

item.name: 3. Live GPS Location & Tracking
item.description: Agent live GPS ping submission, reverse geocoding, admin live map tracking, and agent location breadcrumbs.

request.description: Mobile app calls this endpoint to transmit the agent's live GPS coordinates, battery level, and resolved street address to the server.
Retrieves the most recent location recorded for the authenticated agent.

item.name: Admin Track All Field Agents Live

request.description: Returns latest GPS coordinates, battery, physical address, online/offline status, and direct Google Maps link for every active field agent.
Returns time-ordered GPS breadcrumb path for a specific agent on a given date.

item.name: 4. Attendance & Check-In
item.description: Daily attendance check-in / check-out with GPS coordinates, reverse-geocoded physical address, and history logs.

request.description: Records agent's check-in timestamp, coordinates, and exact address. Generates Google Maps pin and updates live tracking.

{
  "latitude": 12.9716,
  "longitude": 77.5946,
  "accuracy": 3.8,
  "address": "42, 5th Cross, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560038",
  "notes": "Morning field shift check-in"
}

request.description: Records agent's check-out timestamp, coordinates, and calculates total shift working hours.

  "latitude": 12.972,

request.description: Checks whether agent has checked in, checked out, and returns Google Maps links and working duration for today.
Returns list of past attendance records for the authenticated agent.
Admin list of attendance logs with check-in/out times, physical addresses, and Google Maps links.

item.name: 5. Daily Targets
item.description: Admin daily target assignments and Agent real-time target goal vs. achieved progress tracking.

request.description: Returns assigned cash target, donation count target, product units target, along with real-time achieved metrics and percentages.
Lists all agent target goals assigned across dates.

item.name: Admin Assign Daily Target to Agent

request.description: Admin assigns target numbers to an agent for a specific day.
Retrieves specific target assignment details.
Admin updates target figures.
Deletes a target assignment record.

item.name: 6. Donations & Collections

item.name: 7. Payment Records (Admin Financial)
item.description: Financial payment transaction records, settlement status, and revenue breakdown by payment modes (Cash, UPI, Card, Bank Transfer).

request.description: Lists financial transactions with payment mode, donor, agent, settlement status, and reference numbers.
Retrieves payment transaction record details.
Updates settlement status (COMPLETED, PENDING, FAILED, REFUNDED) and reconciliation remarks.
Returns overall financial overview: today's collection, all-time revenue, breakdown by payment modes (UPI, Cash, etc.), and status breakdown.

item.name: 8. Leaves & Weekly-Off Management
item.description: Leave and weekly-off request submissions by agents and admin review/approval/rejection workflow.

item.name: Agent Submit Leave or Weekly-Off Request

request.description: Agent submits a leave or week-off request (request_type: LEAVE or WEEK_OFF). Total days are automatically calculated.
Returns agent's past and pending leave requests with approval status, reviewer name, and admin remarks.
Retrieves single leave request details.
Admin list of leave requests from all field agents.
Admin view of specific leave request.

item.name: Admin Approve or Reject Leave Request

request.description: Admin reviews request with decision (APPROVE or REJECT) and optional remarks. Updates status badge in mobile app.

item.name: 9. Agent User Management (Admin)
